name: exit-deferred-remove
description: Removing a subtree whose root carries __anim.exit emits the root Remove FIRST, flagged with transition:true, and no per-descendant Removes — the renderer owns the exiting subtree's teardown

skip.reason: animation protocol not yet implemented (golang); ForEach source rendering not supported in the typescript runner

input.source: Column { ForEach(items: "@{state.cards}") { Column(key: "@{item.id}") { Text("@{item.title}") Text("@{item.body}") }.exit(fade, duration: 150) } }

steps.description: Initial render creates the card subtree with __anim.exit on its root
Clearing the list removes the animated subtree: exactly one root Remove flagged transition:true, descendants get no Removes of their own
